ascend.note: Kevin takes the kit. Nathaniel moves to keys — the band finally has a healer.
Brice takes the low end. Mat picks up a loop pedal and things stop making sense.
Brian takes the kit. Kevin picks up aux percussion and starts moving the whole room at once.

fields.label: Story
fields.value: Logan founded Faatherton around the year 2000 and has lead the band and been the lead singer, guitarist, and main songwriter ever since. Logan is the beating heart and soul of the Faather-team. There'd literally never have been a Faatherton without Logan. His songwriting skills are the reason we all showed up for 20 years.

fields.label: Story
fields.value: Beau is an amazing guitarist and songwriter. He's been elevating (saving) Faatherton songs for decades and improves every project he's part of. Also providing additional vocals and songwriting for Faatherton, Beau is an inspiration to his fellow bandmates.

fields.label: Story
fields.value: Nathaniel began as the original drummer for Faatherton and became the keyboardist after the turn of the century sometime. Nathaniel rounds out the rock with his harmonies, synth, and a dozen other instruments. Nathaniel has always been an integral member of the group, making the Faath seem like legitimate musicians in public.

fields.label: Story
fields.value: After filling in on keys for a bit, Mat picked up the bass as soon as the position was available. Everyone was happy to have him off the keyboards, especially him. Mat provides backing vocals when the venue has enough mics, and he keeps booze in his bass case. Sometimes he even shares. Good for a laugh. Plays bass with a pick, but we forgive him.

fields.label: Story
fields.value: Kevin is the technical powerhouse of the band. He's played drums on and off since forever, is an asset in the studio, and is the musician the rest of the band learns from and leans on the most. He can play anything that makes sound, and Faatherton would never have been more than a garage band without him.

fields.label: Story
fields.value: A friend of the band before he became the drummer, Brian has been the tempo and spinal column of Faatherton for decades. He's the foundation of the group and the unofficial "manager" of the band. Brian takes care of as much off stage as he does onstage, and onstage he's a beast. Brian is classically trained and an asset in the writing process.

fields.label: Story
fields.value: If you've seen footage of Faatherton, it's likely that Brice captured it. Brice's sense of humor is as valuable as his bass skills, and Faatherton would be hollow without both. Crack a joke, write a killer bass-fill, repeat. Brice is everyone's best friend on and off the stage, and has been for 20+ years.
